page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number at right; below it a framed oval engraving of a man's portrait with a legend running around the oval frame; below the engraving one block of four lines of verse, centred.

main_text.l: GVILELM. D.G. PRINC. AVR. COM. NASS. etc. VICEC. ANTV. et VES. BARO BREDAE, etc. GUB. HOL. SEL. UTR.
Ipsam per hostes & per æratos ruens

page.notes: The engraving shows a bust portrait of a man turned to the left, in a plain collar and armour, inside an oval border; the legend around the oval is partly broken where the frame is worn, so the letters at the upper right ("VICEC. ANTV.") and lower right ("SEL. UTR.") are read from the print with some doubt. The verse lines below the portrait are set in a black letter-influenced italic-like type; "Ipsam" and "ruens" are read with some doubt.
